hooks.availability: source binding only; no hook selected

hooks.meaning: prefetch_v&&prefetch_ready binds active user/absolute row; row staging hit may need zero HBM requests
hooks.name: window_prefetch

hooks.meaning: WC/WS writes and FR/FR_PIPE reads: preserve role, stack, address, sector tag and owned operation ordinal

hooks.meaning: Code-sector completion, separate from scale-sector completion; tagged parent block/user/row/idx required

hooks.meaning: Bind row/user and operation row ordinal; row publication is not stream/descriptor retirement

hooks.meaning: kv_v&&kv_ready plus mask, per descriptor generation; preserve acceptance of each packed beat

hooks.meaning: Schedule done after merge completion, WINDOW service only; mixed selected-CKV job/engine may remain active
hooks.name: window_source

hooks.name: packed_descriptor

hooks.meaning: Bind selection accept serial/reset epoch and sel_vmword; no explicit selection lifetime-retire pulse supplied
hooks.name: selected_ckv_selection

hooks.meaning: VM read/rq_v/id_done and 16 own QDQ4E writes/enc_ov are source progress, not HBM completion

hooks.availability: new passive observation only; no producer repair

hooks.availability: existing conditional ckv_tx metadata + new collector qualification

hooks.availability: existing conditional driver RX metadata + new collector qualification

hooks.meaning: Fifth collector source: selected new row at rankK-1, no HBM fetch and no all-gather loopback

hooks.meaning: All ranks present is availability, not selection or transport retirement. Observe all five sources simultaneously
hooks.name: selected_ckv_rows_ready

hooks.meaning: All owned fetched rows sent and slot/output state drained; not remote collection or selected step retirement
hooks.name: selected_ckv_fetch

hooks.meaning: Per descriptor QK/PV replay jobs are distinct operation IDs referencing same selection epoch
hooks.name: selected_ckv_stream

hooks.meaning: Accepted FP4 packed beat, mask and active replay generation; cannot reset operation deadline
hooks.name: selected_ckv_stream_take

hooks.meaning: Merger job completion retires replay job only; rows_ready/source selection remains reusable
hooks.name: selected_ckv_stream

hooks.availability: existing driver bookkeeping; NOT DUT operation
hooks.meaning: Driver scheduling/delivery fact only. due=max(cycle+11/142,last_due+2 for board); fixed latency subtraction cannot recover enqueue after serialization
hooks.name: driver_selected_ckv_queue

identity_contract.clock: one immutable sample per source rising edge, pre-edge handshake/native qualifiers and explicit observation latency; never count combinational settle iterations
identity_contract.operation: (host reset_epoch64,die_rank2,family,accept_serial64); preserve native user10,pos21,gen16 or selection context
identity_contract.parallelism: independent per-stack request/reply and five collector sources; no single-event serialization that drops simultaneous events
identity_contract.request: operation+ordinal64+client+stack2+tag(low14)+read/write; native slot/sector and row allocation context retained
identity_contract.response: client taken handshake plus native validation and accept-table match; legacy tag reuse requires epoch/fence/no-stale-reply evidence, not just current state/PC
identity_contract.retire: source-owned named completion only; acceptance, staged,rows_ready,PC,busy,link delivery are not interchangeable

limits: provider accepts only immutable observations; no DUT callback/state mutation
pure test association_proven flags are synthetic supplied evidence, not an actual source-binding certificate
no Peirce fault/quiescence or Nash producer-lifecycle repair; only mapped availability/limits

components.name: ckv_own_collector_and_qualification

port_cost.concurrent_event_capacity: WINDOW active-stack request/reply/write-ack, four CKV stack requests/replies, one staged-row request/reply, five CKV collector sources; all independent lanes
port_cost.host_state_not_new_RTL_ports: clock64,reset_epoch64,accept/request serial64 and provider association tables
port_cost.limits: static candidate sufficient-event projection, not proven optimized minimum, area/fanout/routing/clock/SSFF unpriced; no adoption
port_cost.optional_FR_PIPE_basis: refill_epoch11 + issued17 + received17 + pending5 + next5; branch not selected by this model
port_cost.zero_FF_assumption: read-only combinational projections of existing state/qualifiers, host maintains counters; no port or register implemented

unavailable_bounds: admission/backlog/fairness in cycles at each owner mux and PC arbiter
HBM request->matched reply including reachable bank/refresh state, queue occupancy and downstream-ready stalls
